gates.name: Local Software & Test Readiness
gates.required_condition: All data contract and financial correctness regression tests pass (exit code 0)

gates.name: Financial Data Contracts & Invariants
gates.required_condition: Price geometry enforced, share priority guaranteed, valuation outliers unmasked
gates.evidence: In-memory contract invariants validated across Price, ShareResolution, Continuity, and Valuation.

gates.name: Production Database Safety Boundary
gates.required_condition: ALLOW_PRODUCTION_DB_WRITE is False and no unauthorized cloud database writes occur

gates.name: AI Evidence & Local Ollama Inference
gates.required_condition: Evidence grounding enforced; numeric claims tied to verifiable structured citations
gates.evidence: Semantic citation validator active; Ollama local inference verified.

gates.name: Automated Quality Gates & Scheduled Automation
gates.required_condition: ci.yml present and eod_ingestion.yml configured with cron '37 8 * * 1-5'
gates.evidence: ci.yml exists=True, eod_ingestion.yml exists=True, cron verified=True
